title: Shadow Shawl
html:
Shadow Shawl
Piece:  Shoulders
Material:  Cloth (XXLight)
Class palette:  Mage
Quality:  Mythic (rainbow)

Shadow Shawl is the cloth ninja shoulders from items/pal/MageShouldersPAL.gc (PreBuiltWishingWell001). The client sets SoulBound = true. A leather copy in LeatherMythicPAL.gc is marked never went live.

Rolled name endings: Mythic Suffixes.

Fixed mods on this wishing-well template:

  • AGI, INT
  • Max health, Max mana
  • +Fire, +Shadow
  • Divine resist, Shadow resist
